title: Bolo Baba Mere Kab Aaoge
body:
BABA SUGHRA KO KAB BULAOGE
<<MINI>>
BOLO BABA MERE KAB AAOGE
<<DIVIDER>>
QALI GHAR KATNE KO AATA HAI
LOUTKAR KAB WATAM KO AAOGE
Baba Bimari Aur Badti Hai
Dair Se aaoge Tho Na Paaoge
<<MINI>>
Bolo Baba Mere Kab Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Har Ghadi Intezar Karti Hu
Bhai Kab Lene Mujko Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Bolo Baba Mere Kab Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayya Shadi Ka Teri Armaan Hai
Apni Shadi Mei Kab Bulaoge
<<MINI>>
Bolo Baba Mere Kab Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Ye Kheta Hai Tum Dulhan Ke Sath
Shera Bandhe Lahaad se aaoge
<<MINI>>
Bolo Baba Mere Kab Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba Asghar ki Yaad Aati Hai
Uski Aawaz Kab Sunaoge
<<MINI>>
Bolo Baba Mere Kab Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Khena Asghar Se Yaad Karti hoon
Jab Bhi Jhula Ushe Jhulaoge
<<MINI>>
Bolo Baba Mere Kab Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Mei Kyon Ye Qayal Aata Hai
Baad Marne Ke Mere Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Bolo Baba Mere Kab Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Qath Ke Aqir Mei Moosvi Tha Likha
Sughra Marjaegi Na Aaoge
